name: 3D Greedy Meshing
definition: Extends 2D greedy meshing to three dimensions by extracting 2D slices from the 3D voxel grid along each axis and processing them with the 2D algorithm.
summary: 3D Greedy Meshing reduces voxel triangle counts by decomposing the problem into six directional 2D sub-problems, merging adjacent visible faces into larger quads.
